summary: Backend regression passed 3/3. Public mobile preview loaded, TestUser1 login succeeded, Werft calculator opened, all requested component options were present, controlled quantities updated, and calculated stats rendered.

ui_bugs.issue: Source testID props do not become data-testid attributes in the browser DOM. Required selectors such as player-username-input, open-calculator-btn and drive-type-select are absent; semantic/ID fallbacks were required for testing.

action_items: Expose stable browser data-testid attributes (or accessible labels) for the required login, calculator, shipyard, and spaceport controls.
Run a follow-up end-to-end registration-with-invite and Observatory-to-Spaceport autofill test; these were not executed in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend auth initialization and component validation are covered by the passing regression suite.
Referenced SpaceportTab and ShipyardTab contain controlled React state and no document.getElementById usage.
Calculator option catalogs and rendered formula outputs were verified against the requested component families.
seed_data_creation: The existing regression test creates a single-use admin invite and TEST_formula design when the prototype slot permits; no new player was registered by this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use https://code-review-tool-44.preview.emergentagent.com and mobile viewport 375x667. Browser DOM omits React testID props; use #player-username-input/#player-password-input and semantic selectors until data-testid support is corrected.
rca_of_issue: React DOM ignores the nonstandard testID prop used throughout these web-rendered components, so the requested data-testid selectors never exist. The controls function, but automation and accessibility stability are reduced.
